plans.title: Milliken global accounts — Q1 2027 push
plans.body:
**Objective:** Deepen specification with top 5 A&D firms in the Pacific NW and convert 2 global accounts into multi-region programs.

**Key targets:** CannonDesign, Convergence, and two national developers in senior living / multifamily.

**Moves:**
- Lunch-and-learns on the durable modular + PVC-free story
- Get onto 3 standards/spec lists
- Quarterly business review with each global account

**Risks:** Incumbent pricing pressure; lead times.

**Metrics:** # specs secured, pipeline $ created, win rate vs. incumbents.
